name: Shadow March
title: Shadow March
summary: Shadow March is a large blackened former battlefield: an obsidian plain (z 30) around a black hill that rises 88 m to a rounded summit (z 118), with The Dark Spiral portal on top. Lord Marsan's battlefield lies at its foot: golden skeletons, fallen armoured bodies, staves and torn red-and-gold banners lie in clusters north-west and south of the hill. On the west edge, Grael's Chamber portal stands between two 7.9 m Black Spear Ice Totems. Shadow Wraiths and Nightmares roam.

landmarks.name: The Dark Spiral portal (summit)
landmarks.note: Spawn on the hilltop. The hill rises from z 30 to z 118 within 90 m.

landmarks.name: South battlefield
landmarks.note: About 40 corpse, skeleton and banner statics (0x020003CC/CD, 0x02001310/11, 0x0200152A/B) on the flat obsidian.

landmarks.name: North-west battlefield
landmarks.note: The larger cluster, Lord Marsan's log book area.

landmarks.name: Grael's Chamber portal and Ice Totems
landmarks.note: Black Spear Ice Totems 0x020015E5 at (7681.8,28287.9) and (7681.7,28280.9). Landblock 0x2793 to the west is not in the kit.

site.name: Shadow March
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the obsidian plain at (8010,28150), ground 30, 28 m from the nearest spawn. The Dark Spiral portal teleport is on the summit and would touch the portal.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (danbys-outpost -> fort-tethana).

shots.standingOrder: Low over the fallen of Lord Marsan's battlefield south of the hill, roll slowly off level while creeping 1 m toward the corpses and torn banners with the black hill of Shadow March looming behind; stay 2 m above the dead.
shots.notes: Dutch angle for a haunted battlefield. Lord Marsan's dead (golden skeletons, fallen armoured bodies and torn red-and-gold banners lying on the obsidian) are scattered across the black plain south of the hill. The lens is 3.5 m above them, 16 m south, and rolls from -4 to +13 deg while creeping 1.2 m in. The black hill of Shadow March fills the top of the frame, with its summit at the frame edge (ndc y 0.66-1.0). The sun is behind the left shoulder. shots.standingOrder: Circle the summit of the blackened hill clockwise 48 m out and 16 m above the Dark Spiral portal, keeping the swirl centred over the obsidian plain; hold height.
shots.notes: The drone circles the summit of the blackened hill clockwise from bearing 200 to 240 deg. It stays 48 m out and 16 m above The Dark Spiral portal, the swirl on the hilltop (z 117), 87 m above the obsidian plain. The plain, the battlefield and the far ridges turn behind the swirl. The south-west sun is behind the lens.
